reading.author_results_distinction: 正文全部实测指标均为作者报告；12/68、2/55、加权值35.77%及机制示例为基于公式/表格的算术解释，非新实验。
reading.notes: HTML在嵌套表格的交叉引用上出现转换错位，例如§4.4多个链接指表8；PDF分别正确指表6、7、8。正文表号以PDF为准，未将HTML转换错误归咎于作者。

task_and_model.contribution_type: benchmark / simulation scenes / executable evaluation protocol; no newly proposed NavVerse high-level navigation model

tasks.ObjNav: 类别物体搜索，可到达任意合法实例
tasks.PlaceNav: 室外功能场所搜索，仅室外与室内到室外

task_and_model.zero_shot: Four pretrained baselines evaluated with common physics stack; do not infer training on the released NavVerse train split.

embodiments.unevaluated: Humanoid/bipedal and additional embodiments described as extensible interfaces only.
embodiments.no_hardware_experiment_claim: 本文没有真实机器人定量实验。仓库内Spot README描述上游AI Institute/Spot RL硬件部署致谢，real_world_exp_server存在亦不构成本论文硬件实验结果。

runtime.discrete_action_sim_seconds: approximately 1 s, until motion primitive completes
runtime.parallelism: up to 3 simulations per 48 GB L40S as reported by authors
runtime.caution: Do not equate simulation/control/rendering rates with VLA decision frequency or guaranteed wall-clock real time.

paper_protocol.task_generation: 5–50 m reference paths; successful physics rollout, >5 and <=100 simulation seconds, >5 and <50 m travel, no failure termination
paper_protocol.observations: forward RGB-D 640×480, ground-truth robot base pose, camera calibration and robot size; no added depth noise; no IMU
metric_cautions: Success distance subtracts goal size radius before applying 1.0+robot radius; Spot radius 0.6m.
Table 5 failures are conditional percentages among failed episodes.
Table 4 post-exit failure proportions condition on failed episodes reaching outdoors.
CR is trajectory collision incidence, not per-step count.
CE is distinct visited 1m grid cells per path meter.

github.code_status: Public source files for simulator, robot wrappers, controller, task/scene utilities and several baseline adapters are present.
github.code_license: Apache-2.0; Isaac Lab-derived code BSD-3-Clause, TidyBot meshes MIT, other components separate
baseline_gaps: SGImagineNav is not registered in current public AGENT_REGISTRY and no corresponding adapter was located in full public repository tree. Its separate official SGImagineNav repository exists for HM3D experiments, which is not evidence of a NavVerse adapter.
PoliFormer registration says it has not passed public clean-install and action-mapping checks.
UniNaVid README notes upstream package/version declarations prevent a clean pip check.

assets_listed: prebuilt navmesh assets as specified in data card and downloader validation
raw meshes and older scene packages

dataset.scope_limit: File presence, sizes, API openness, one parsed episode sample and checksum verified; full archive extraction and completeness not tested.

spot_locomotion.status: file exists in official public Git tree; not downloaded or loaded
spot_locomotion.license: README explicitly distinguishes project-provided checkpoint from source-code license

uninavid.status: public, ungated API; two pytorch_model shards listed under uninavid-7b-full-224-video-fps-1-grid-2; not downloaded/loaded

longnav_r1.status: public, ungated API; adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors present; base model also required; not downloaded/loaded

weights.new_navverse_navigation_checkpoint: not applicable: paper proposes a benchmark, not a new high-level navigation policy

paper_release_mismatch.paper: 100 indoor/50 outdoor/50 hybrid scenes; 9,100 train/900 eval episodes
paper_release_mismatch.interpretation: Current release manifest and runnable scene inventory do not directly match paper Table 13. Do not claim exact table reproduction from the default released split. Additional legacy/helper episodes exist but were not reconciled into the paper split.
